rates.source_name: JNTO budget guide: double-room reference
assumptions: Double rooms use the guide's midrange starting point of JPY 10000, not its single-room price. Typical and upper allowances use explicit 1.25 and 1.5 planning factors; neither is an observed hotel quote.
Two adults per room. Accommodation taxes, peak dates and specific hotel standards require confirmation.

rates.source_name: JNTO budget guide: midrange/four-star double-room references
assumptions: Scenario allowances span guide starting points for midrange and four-star double rooms; the midpoint is a planning assumption, not a market average.
Two adults per room. No property availability or date-specific hotel rate is asserted.

rates.source_name: JNTO budget guide: four/five-star double-room references
assumptions: Guide starting points anchor the lower and typical allowances. Upper allowance adds an explicit 50 percent planning margin to the five-star starting point; it is not a quoted ceiling.
Two adults per room. Premium dining and private transfers need separate supported allowances.

rates.source_name: JNTO budget guide: casual meal anchors
assumptions: Model per person per day: breakfast 400/550/700 + two meals at 650/1300/1950 + water 110. Lunch/dinner multiples of the casual-meal anchor are transparent planning assumptions.
No alcohol, fine dining or dietary surcharge is priced. All travelers use adult allowances.

rates.source_name: Tokyo Metro adult day ticket; airport allowance anchored in JNTO guide
assumptions: Public subway travel uses a daily adult-ticket anchor with 25/50 percent planning margins. Daily ticket purchase is assumed instead of optimizing pass durations.

Includes a fixed JPY 6400 per traveler airport-transfer reserve (two JPY 3200 guide examples, https://www.japan.travel/en/guide/japan-on-a-budget/). Actual airport, eligibility and transfers require confirmation; no airport or route is selected here.
Taxis, private transfers and travel outside the city are not covered by this public-transport model.

rates.source_name: Tokyo National Museum adult collection-admission reference
assumptions: Daily activity allowance is one/two/three collection-admission equivalents; it does not imply visiting this museum or quote tickets for the actual selected attractions.
Ordinary sightseeing only. Theme parks, guided tours, special exhibitions and premium experiences need matching references or a separate user allowance.

rates.source_name: JAL advertised economy round-trip snapshot, not a trip-date quote
assumptions: Public examples observed: INR 108028 for February 22-28, 2027 and INR 128532 for January 14-26, 2027. These are different dates from the requested trip and may be unavailable.
Typical uses the higher observed example; upper adds an explicit 50 percent planning margin. Neither is an actual-date fare or statistical market range.
Adult economy round trip even for a luxury stay style. Optional baggage, origin-airport access and business-class upgrades are excluded.

rates.source_name: ANA advertised economy round-trip examples, not trip-date quotes
assumptions: Examples span December 24, 2026-January 2, 2027 (Narita) through February 22-26, 2027 (Haneda). Typical uses a Narita example; airport/date differences explain the broad range.
Adult economy round trip; dates, airport selection, availability and ancillary fees are unverified. This is not a market ceiling.

rates.source_name: ANA advertised economy round-trip examples, not trip-date quotes
assumptions: Examples observed for November 11-24 and December 21, 2026-January 5, 2027. Upper adds an explicit 50 percent planning margin; it is not a provider maximum.
Adult economy round trip; different requested dates can cost more. No booking availability or ancillary fees are verified.

rates.source_name: ANA advertised economy round-trip examples, not trip-date quotes

rates.source_name: Air India Express requested-date advertised starting-fare snapshot (HYD-BLR outbound)

additional_sources.name: Air India Express requested-date advertised starting-fare snapshot (BLR-HYD return)

assumptions: Point allowance sums advertised adult economy starting fares observed 2026-10-12 for HYD-BLR on 2026-10-13 (INR 4,940) and BLR-HYD on 2026-10-17 (INR 10,547).

The provider states that displayed fares were collected within the previous 48 hours and may no longer be available. Values changed during review, so this is a low-confidence historical planning snapshot, not a live quote or availability confirmation.
Optional products, airport access, fare changes and traveler-specific charges may be additional. The allowance applies only to this exact route and date pair and is multiplied by the traveler count.

rates.source_name: Air India Express requested-date advertised starting-fare snapshot (HYD-DXB outbound)

additional_sources.name: Air India Express requested-date advertised starting-fare snapshot (DXB-HYD return)
Central Bank of the UAE exchange rates against AED for VAT-related obligations

assumptions: Point allowance uses advertised adult economy starting fares observed 2026-10-12 for HYD-DXB on 2026-10-20 (INR 15,004) and DXB-HYD on 2026-10-24 (AED 618).

The return fare is converted deterministically with the Central Bank of the UAE 2026-10-12 VAT reference rate of AED 0.038345 per INR: AED 618 / 0.038345 = INR 16,116.83 after ROUND_HALF_UP to two decimals. The per-person round-trip point allowance is therefore INR 31,120.83.
The central-bank table is a dated reference conversion, not a retail card/cash exchange quote. No conversion spread, fee or later exchange-rate movement is represented.

The airline states that displayed fares were collected within the previous 48 hours and may no longer be available. This is a low-confidence historical planning snapshot, not a live quote or availability confirmation.
Optional products, airport access, fare changes and traveler-specific charges may be additional. The allowance applies only to this exact route and date pair and is multiplied by the traveler count.
